tagline: ESA flagship to Jupiter — first orbiter ever to settle around a Galilean moon (Ganymede, 2034)
description: Jupiter Icy Moons Explorer. Launched 2023-04-14 on an Ariane 5 ECA+ for an 8.5-year cruise via Earth-Venus-Earth-Earth gravity assists to Jupiter arrival in July 2031. Once in the Jovian system, JUICE flies ~35 times past Europa, Ganymede, and Callisto before entering Ganymede orbit in 2034 — the first spacecraft to orbit a moon other than Earth's. Ten-instrument payload includes ice-penetrating radar (RIME), spectrometers, magnetometer, and a laser altimeter, optimised to characterise the three icy moons as potentially habitable subsurface-ocean worlds.
best_known_for: ESA Jupiter flagship — first orbiter ever around a Galilean moon (Ganymede), arrival 2031-2034
